items.summary: Add a fast preflight that runs only the drift-prone generated-output checks and tells the agent whether a full build refresh is needed before the expensive gate.
items.why: Session 165 only caught stale public-intelligence artifacts inside the full build:check run. A targeted preflight catches the same class near session start and closeout, saving minutes and making generated truth failures obvious.
items.recipe: Create scripts/check-generated-drift-preflight.mjs with self-test and --json modes, run public-intelligence/heartbeat/founder-presence/nav-sheet/llms generated checks, and wire it near the front of package.json build:check.

items.summary: Add a week-over-week RUM canary that compares the latest field window to the previous field window and warns before the perf budget hard-fails.
items.why: The RUM bridge is wired, but the next-order value is drift detection, not just pass/fail. A canary lets the site notice degrading field LCP/CLS while the strict flip is still waiting on sufficient samples.
items.recipe: Create scripts/check-rum-anomaly-canary.mjs that reads data/rum-history.ndjson, compares latest and prior 7-day route windows, emits .cache/rum-anomaly-canary.json, supports --check/--self-test, and wire check mode into build:check as advisory.

items.summary: Turn the ambient coverage Markdown into a machine-readable candidate list with proof commands and risk notes.
items.why: The report already finds heavy guarded modules, but humans still have to re-read Markdown and infer the next move. A JSON candidate artifact lets future audits and agents choose the next split without burning context.
items.recipe: Extend scripts/report-ambient-coverage.mjs to write .cache/ambient-split-candidates.json containing ranked guarded modules, recommended first proof step, and the forbidden-source guard status.

items.summary: Add a local contract that fails when the public CI status artifact is stale or malformed, so the site does not publish false operational confidence.
items.why: api/ci-status.json is public-facing trust material. A freshness check keeps the brand anchor from showing old CI truth as current health.
items.recipe: Create scripts/check-ci-status-freshness.mjs with --max-age-hours and --self-test, validate api/ci-status.json shape/freshness, and wire it into build:check with a practical freshness window.

executionLog.notes: Added scripts/check-generated-drift-preflight.mjs and wired it first in build:check. It caught stale llms-full-shards after both initial audit work and public-oracle-feed refresh; final preflight green.
Added scripts/check-ci-status-freshness.mjs with self-test and 96h build gate. Adjusted summary contract to match the existing public artifact's string shape.
Added scripts/check-rum-anomaly-canary.mjs. It compares latest vs previous RUM windows, emits .cache/rum-anomaly-canary.json, and passes check mode with empty history.
Extended scripts/report-ambient-coverage.mjs to emit .cache/ambient-split-candidates.json. Current artifact reports 11 guarded split candidates.
